en.answer: Monsters on the field will be Zombie-Type. Due to the ②nd effect of <<5533>>, any effects that change the Type of monsters in the Graveyard will not be applied. Therefore, the Type of monsters in the Graveyard is unchanged.
en.question: If both <<7857>> and <<5533>> are face-up in the field zones, what happens to the Type of monsters on the field or in the Graveyard?
en.title: If both <<7857>> and <<5533>> are on the field, what happens to the Type of monsters on the field or in the Graveyard?

ja.answer: フィールドのモンスターの種族はアンデット族になります。「<<5533>>」の②の効果により、墓地のモンスターの種族を変更する効果は適用されず、墓地のモンスターの種族は変わりません。
